reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Abbie’s Dog House on Maple enough! Moncho has stayed here for both daycare and boarding, and the fact that he is genuinely excited and happy every time he goes says everything to me.

I am extremely particular about who I trust with Moncho, and there are very few people or places where I feel completely comfortable leaving him. Abbie’s Dog House has absolutely earned that trust. I know he is safe, well cared for, and treated with genuine affection while he is there.

I especially want to recognize Kim, who has been absolutely wonderful with Moncho and with us. She is kind, attentive, and clearly cares about the dogs she looks after. Knowing that Moncho is with people who genuinely care about him gives me tremendous peace of mind.

I also want to thank the owner, who has gone above and beyond to accommodate our schedule when we needed some flexibility. That level of understanding and willingness to help has made a huge difference for us and is something we truly appreciate.

Having a place where I can leave Moncho without worrying, and where he is actually excited to walk through the door, is priceless. Thank you Kim, the owner, and everyone at Abbie’s Dog House for taking such great care of him. You have absolutely earned our trust and loyalty! 🐾❤️

Arrived this morning to pick up my dog, no one was there. I was, albeit very close to 10, still there within the 9-10am window. Doors locked, no one answering the door or any of the phones at either location. Clearly whoever was there just left early.
Taking great care of my grand-dog for years!

I came in from out of town and they were able to make accommodations for my elderly dog on short notice. The staff was very friendly and made me feel at ease about leaving her there. While she was staying, they gave me updates over the phone letting me know she was doing well, which I really appreciated.

When I picked her up she was happy, smelled great, and it was clear the lodging and bedding were clean. Overall it was a really positive experience. I highly recommend them and only wish they were closer to where I live so I could use them more often.

The best place in Dallas to leave you dog for
The day or overnight. My dog is happy here and well taken care of.
Both of my dogs love coming here. Staff is always friendly. Prices are some of the best in town.

Again I have to RAVE on these amazing team members of Abbie’s Doghouse on Maple. My  response to anyone who asks about the people and the company is that they treat your fur kids as their own. And, once again, they came through today. Without getting in to the details, suffice to say I so appreciate Suzy reaching out to confirm some details and once again looking out for our crew! You all are the BEST!!!

The dog care service itself is good my pets were treated well and the staff seemed caring. However, the receptionist was very rude and disrespectful during my visit. her attitude made the whole experience uncomfortable. I hope management addresses this issue, because good service deserves professional and polite front desk staff.

I had to give one star because otherwise I couldn’t post this. I came here expecting the best, but unfortunately, the experience was disappointing. The customer service was poor, communication was lacking, and there was a clear lack of transparency. The lady at the front desk was especially unprofessional, rude, and unhelpful. I do not recommend

Can’t recommend enough! We’ve been taking our dogs to Abbie’s for years - they’re our go-to for boarding because they really love our pack of three as their own. Amazing staff and the cage-less format is so fun for our social & playful pups. Abbie’s has worked with us during life events and family emergencies, they consistently keep us updated with daily pics when we’re traveling, and (most importantly) they adore our pups (and our pups love them). Reasonable pricing too, especially in DFW. We love being a part of the Abbie’s family!

I have been taking my pup Sampson here for almost 3 years now for boarding. This place is the best and we always get update pictures on there Facebook. They make booking super easy and they are always so nice! I highly recommend!
Great place recommend for all boarding needs

Abbie's staff is wonderful! My dog goes once a week or maybe a little bit less for daycare. When we walk in, she is always greeted by name and the staff is so kind. I have always felt like my dog and I are both very well taken care of here. One day my dog was nervous to go in and I called to check in a couple of hours later and they were quick to give an update on how she is and also said to call any time. I have taken her to another facility where they would not do a tour of the facility. I appreciated that Abbie's was transparent and let me go back and see the facility as well. Abbie's is great pricing for great service! Thank you for taking care of my sweet Penny Rae!
